notes.title: Variety Update
notes.content:
This update marks the release of the promised character reworks along with new items, new guns, new NPCs and more general balancing changes. Eight of the fourteen characters received some level of changes/reworks. Eight new guns and two new weapons have added more variety to gameplay. Four new items have been added. New "Enforcer" class NPCs have been added relating to stores. General balancing changes have been made to many different things across the game, most notably the player damage system has been reworked. As always more details below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42722056/79fad8ef31d579e66d75f4a34d863474e8f23095.png[/img]


[b]Character changes/reworks:[/b]
[u]Veteran[/u] Can now carry a second gun/weapon in place of an item.
[u]Warrior[/u] Now has an "undying" ability. When charged and reduced below one health, instead of dying will enter a "bleeding out state". This state only lasts a short time and then results in death, however if you use any medical items you will be healed and taken out of the "bleeding out state." The ability starts charged and will be recharged when you heal to full.
[u]Ranger[/u] Power shots spawn more often.
[u]Survivor[/u] Gets slightly more ammo from pickups.
[u]Slayer[/u] Bullets readjust to follow the crosshair.
[u]Soldier[/u] Care packages now spawn at the beginning of most levels. They contain a good amount of stuff, but aren't equivalent to airdrops. No longer starts with an airdrop signal, instead has the new airstrike beacon item.
[u]Businessman[/u] All bullets are hollowpoints.
[u]Monster[/u] All bullets are incendiary. New "Enforcer" class NPCs automatically spawn.

[b]New guns/weapons:[/b]
[u]M9[/u] A highly accurate pistol with a high rate of fire. Spawns in Rare crates.
[u]AR-MOD[/u] An AR style rifle with occasional shotgun blasts. Spawns in Survivor crates.
[u]Lever Action Shotgun[/u] A shotgun that increases rate of fire as you fire it. Spawns in Survivor crates.
[u]Scatter Machine Gun[/u] Similar to the Scatter Rifle/Pistol, but in a more automatic form. Spawns in Ultra crates.
[u]M249[/u] A belt fed machine gun with a large magazine. Spawns in Military crates.
[u]Phantom[/u] A short barrel rifle that creates a cloud of smoke on reload. Spawns in Military crates.
[u]Prototype Fury[/u] A long rifle that has a burst of 22cal bullets on reload. Spawns in Bandit crates.
[u]Prototype Phoenix[/u] A sub machine gun that occasionally creates a burst of flames. Spawns in Bandit crates.
[u]Blowtorch[/u] Low tier flamethrower. Spawns in Common crates.
[u]Crossbow[/u] Shoots new arrow projectiles. Spawns in Uncommon crates.

-The Blowtorch and Crossbow assets have existed since before launch. We finally found a way for them to fit into the weapon line up. A Crossbow or Bow and Arrow has been suggested by players for a long time.

[b]New items:[/b]
[u]Disruptor Level 1[/u] Creates a wave that causes zombies to retreat and destroys spawn shots.
[u]Disruptor Level 2[/u] Creates several waves that causes zombies to retreat and destroys spawn shots.
[u]Military Medkit[/u] Heals you for six hit points and "overheals" you for the difference plus three.
[u]Airstrike Beacon[/u] Creates many targets in the area around where it is placed. A barrages of explosions come down on every target.

-The Disruptors were requested to give players some way to deal with projectiles. The Military Medkit was added to give players a higher tier healing item that's worth carrying in the late game. Airstrikes were added to be the ultimate destructive item, making the split grenade look like nothing. 
[b]

[b]Damage system overhaul:[/b]
There used to be several ways to be one hit in the game. This was never intentional and can really discourage players. After taking damage, you are now unable to take more damage for the next second to health or armor. Granted the amount of damage depends on the source. Don't go try and hug bosses, they will still one hit you.

New "Enforcer" class NPCs:[/b]
Stores have become easier to rob now that the store keepers have to shoot several times to kill you. The "Enforcer" class NPCs will spawn after boss fights if you've killed the previous store keeper. Only one will spawn per level generally, but you can always run away from them. If you run they will meet you again in the next boss level. It is possible to have three Enforcers in a level if you keep running.

[b]Changes and additions:[/b]
New "overheal" system in place. If you are "overhealed" and below six health it'll heal you one hit point every second until you are at full or the reserve is depleted.
New arrow projectiles have a chance to not break and be picked up.
Player night vision increased
Spawn shots now glow in the dark
Ghost shots now glow in the dark
Vampire shots now glow in the dark
Alphas now glow in the dark
Acid crawlers now glow in the dark
Bosses now glow in the dark
Bosses drop loot when they die
Power shots for sale in certain stores
Military Medkits for sale in certain stores
World map tile added to mansion
Npcs now are more accurate
Riot Zombies now either drop level 1 armor or a medium ammo pack
Sniper bullets no longer pierce NPCs
Rifle bullets can no longer pierce NPCs

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
No new reported bugs and the list is currently empty.

[b]Other news:[/b]
Z-Stop is currently on sale for 25% for the duration of the Spring Sale until 3/21/2024

notes.title: Modes Update
notes.content:
This update has been in the works for a very long time. It consists of two new game modes, new guns, new characters and a Katana. The monsters of Halloween mode have returned in the new "Cursed" mode; You are trapped on an island where night is eternal, fight different waves of monsters as the moon changes and defeat three new bosses to escape. Hone your skills in boss fights in the new "Boss Rush" mode; Enter a battle arena where the walls are always shifting and you must make difficult choices which lead to unique fast paced combat. The new XM-SPEAR offers a new high tier weapon that has bullets that travel at a faster rate, but a smaller magazine; In addition a "new" automatic AK-47 has been added, with the existing burst fire AK-47 being renamed to AKM. Beating the side modes give you fun achievements to show off, but we wanted there to be more of a reward; There are now four new characters, each can be unlocked by beating/reaching a certain point in the four side game modes. There's also now a Katana, its powerful and hidden somewhere, find it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42722056/dcf3e2d5e4584d4f8758c8c439d798ea635320e0.png[/img]

[b]New characters:[/b]
[u]The Champion[/u]
Unlocked by reaching wave 30 in Gladiator mode. Increases the rate of fire of most guns.
[u]The Sentinel[/u]
Unlocked by surviving 120 seconds in Eclipse mode. Increases your max armor cap by 6.
[u]The Monger[/u]
Unlocked by beating Cursed mode. Spirits rise from the dead to assist you.
[u]The Conqueror[/u]
Unlocked by beating Boss Rush mode. All bullets are explosive and explosions don't damage you. 

[b]Changes and additions:[/b]
AK-47 renamed to AKM
Automatic AK-47 added
XM-SPEAR added
Katana added
Champion character added
Sentinel character added
Monger character added
Conqueror character added
Extra armor bar added for use with Sentinel character
Fire grenades now just create fire and no explosion

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
Store guards now aggro against the Monster
ESC key press crash bug fixed


[b]Other notes:[/b]
There is a new trailer for the game now on the store page which shows some of the new content in action.

notes.title: Halloween Mode Update
notes.content:
Halloween was yesterday and with it came a new limited time mode. Unfortunately due to some miscommunication we were unable to make a post about it until now. Halloween mode will be active until November 14th. Halloween mode is a modification of Survival where the majority of enemies have been replaced. These enemies consist of Werewolves, Vampires and Ghosts.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42722056/80fcc581cb399526bd6706be509730df735b65d9.png[/img]


[b]Werewolves:[/b]

Packwolf
A standard movement enemy with a bit of health
Direwolf
Stays it's distance then will occasionally run in to attack
Brute
It's big, it's strong, and it's fast. Run.

[b]Vampires:
[/b]
Bat
Simple flying unit.

Vampire
Throwing knives and turning into bats.

Gargoyle
Big flying unit that shoots particles and spawns bats.

[b]Ghosts:[/b]

Spirit
Slow moving unit that goes through walls
Spector
Keeps it's distance, but fires particles. Also goes through walls. 

Banshee
Strong, fast and dangerous.

[b]Additional enemies:[/b]

Undead
Rotting moving corpses, similar to regular infected, but with more health.

Pumpkin Demon
If you're lucky you won't find it.

[b]Changes and additions:[/b]
Along with the new enemies pumpkins and jack o lantern have been added.
When in Halloween mode it is always dusk.
Otherwise there have been no real changes made to the game.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Soldier character playable when locked bug has been fixed

[b]Things to come:[/b]
We've been working on content for Halloween for a while. We really wanted to use the holiday to add content that normally wouldn't fit with the theme of our game. That being said there is a bunch of content that wasn't ready in time. While Halloween mode will be disabled on the 14th(to return next year). A permanent new game mode containing the new enemies added with this update and along with other content is in the works. That's all for now.

notes.title: Characters Update
notes.content:
This update has been in the works for a very long time. Additional characters have been added. These characters can be unlocked by reaching levels, beating bosses, and by other means. These characters bring new play styles and a variety of starting kits to the game. In addition certain characters have bonuses such as faster speed, npc store discount, chance of healing from melee kills and many more.
Characters will provide goals for players to reach which will often give them advantages in the early game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42722056/f7532801249c2485f15edf5363fb40f49a6cb7e9.png[/img]

Changes and additions:
Npc store item prices will now appear when you are within range of said item.
Player dark vision has been increased.
Gladiator and Eclipse mode now have unique base characters(these are just skins, they have no bonuses and are not playable in the Survival.)
Levers have had an art overhaul.

Bug fixes:
At the moment there are few to no known bugs

Things to come:
This update involved a lot of overhauling systems and art work. It took us about a month to complete. While there likely won't be any big core changing updates similar in scale to characters or npc stores any time soon. We're going to see how people react to this update and look to continue to improve gameplay and player experience. However there are still things to come. As always no spoilers, yet we dare say you can expect something spooky coming your way.

Npc store item prices will now appear when you are within range of said item.

notes.title: Store Update
notes.content:
Players will now encounter npc run stores after level 1,4, and 7. Each store has a supply of items and weapons that will help you along you way that you can purchase for a cost of ammo. However if you're low on ammo or looking to go down a more criminal path, you can always attempt to rob stores. Fair warning store keepers are armed to the teeth and won't hesitate to shoot you dead. Actions have consequences and word travels fast. If you go on a killing spree, you may find that other store keepers will start to incorporate armed guards for extra security. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42722056/7aae2a23603664acf41c20262073535bbadf39b0.png[/img]
Changes and additions:
Zombies will now occasionally drop little bits of armor, health and ammo.
A new faction has been officially added: "The Syndicate" 
New golden dragon symbols are placed near Syndicate controlled areas.

Bug fixes:
Chainsaws now damage Gladiator bosses
 Tiling bug fixes


Things to come:
That's all for this first update. While we we're keeping things under wraps for now, we have began to work on the next update. Lets just say you'll be seeing lots of new faces real soon.
